item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.
After the follow-up, the final result is square 1:1 (the user changed the shape from any shape); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it square and keep everything else the same.

style.prompt: Luxury editorial product photograph of a premium scented candle, one elegant smoked amber glass vessel with thick glass base and creamy ivory wax, small gently glowing flame. Minimal refined ivory paper label with beautifully legible small black serif typography reading "EMBER" and below "SANTAL & FIG". Matching matte charcoal lid resting beside the candle. Sculptural warm beige travertine pedestal, seamless warm taupe studio background, sophisticated restrained styling with a subtle fig leaf and small sandalwood fragment near the base. Dramatic soft directional window light from upper left, deep delicate shadows, warm highlights through amber glass, exquisite realistic material textures, luxury niche fragrance advertising, medium format camera, 85mm product lens, crisp focus on candle and label, subtle background falloff, balanced negative space, art-directed premium composition, no people, no clutter, no watermark.
